intent: Inspect and refactor TelemetryMeters without changing the ast_hints surface or the tests' behavior (never seal or finalize a type another unit stubs; no magic numbers, no blocking calls, no raw logger calls beyond the claimed step logs). Unit contract: Single owner of the Micrometer meter names and bounded tags of the context (tags are enumerations only, NEVER deviceId): counters telemetry.packets.received{source_kind}, telemetry.samples.validated{metric,status}, telemetry.samples.reordered{metric}, telemetry.revisions.appended{reason}; timer telemetry.pipeline.latency{stage in validate,history}. Consumers pin this unit and never spell meter names. Registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration (no stereotype annotation). Metrics are asserted through an injected SimpleMeterRegistry.
